map.可交互乘法表，随机出题，计时练习: Interactive multiplication table with random questions and timed practice
map.📖 查看「九九乘法表 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Nine-by-Nine Multiplication Table User Guide"
map.九九乘法表共 45 项（1×1 至 9×9 的三角表含对角线）或 81 项全表；: The nine-by-nine table has 45 entries (the triangular table from 1×1 to 9×9 including the diagonal) or 81 entries in full form; each cell value = row number × column number, as in 7 × 8 = 56. In training mode questions are drawn at random and scored by accuracy, where accuracy = correct answers ÷ total questions × 100%; in timed mode the average time per question = total time ÷ number of questions.
map.点击格子可以高亮查看: Click a cell to highlight it
map.📚 深度解析：展示 1-9 乘法口诀表，支持指定数查询与高亮，辅助乘法识记。: 📚 In-depth: shows the 1-9 multiplication table with look-up and highlighting for a given number, helping memorize multiplication.
map.单表查询：查某数倍数列。: Single table: look up the multiples of one number.
map.默认 1-9，部分扩展至 12。: 1-9 by default, extended to 12 in some versions.
map.小学乘法启蒙与背诵。: Introducing multiplication and learning it by heart in primary school.
